name: Keryn Sylvius
summary: On the second floor of Goldshire’s Lion’s Pride Inn, Keryn Sylvius trains young rogues. In the reading room, she teaches stealth and bladecraft and quietly guides promising operatives toward Stormwind’s intelligence service.

sections.title: A Quiet Presence in Goldshire
sections.body: Keryn Sylvius keeps to the reading room above the Lion’s Pride Inn. Downstairs, travelers crowd the floor with town guards, while upstairs she watches the steady flow of road gossip. She mentors rogues learning their trade in Elwynn Forest. When promising operatives outgrow petty theft and roadside skulduggery, Sylvius discreetly sends them to Stormwind City to contact SI:7.

faq.q: Where can I find Keryn Sylvius?
faq.answer: Find Keryn Sylvius in the small reading room on the second floor of the Lion’s Pride Inn in Goldshire.
Keryn Sylvius trains rogues, teaching new abilities, resetting talent specializations, and guiding their progress.

faq.q: What connection does she have to SI:7?
faq.answer: Once operatives prove their abilities, Sylvius directs them to seek out Master Mathias Shaw and SI:7 in Old Town, where Stormwind’s covert intelligence network is based.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can learn from Sylvius in Elwynn Forest. When you are ready, she can point you toward SI:7 headquarters in Stormwind City.
As an Alliance member, you can count on Sylvius to keep covert eyes on Elwynn’s main roads from her post above Goldshire’s crossroads.
